header.description:
Behavior Pack for Bedrock Infection Add-on. Infected pig attacks and infects players causing Blindness for 10s.

Lore: The Parasite Project — Discovered in late 2026 by Dr. I. M. Forsythe, the parasite was a failed bioengineering attempt to increase livestock resilience. The parasite adapted, infecting swine and later spilling into humans. The first recorded outbreak began on 2026-10-17 at a remote farm. Survivors report temporary blindness and disorientation. An antidote was developed by modder3127.

Created by: modder3127 on 2026-10-17
